blocks.text: Filipino rap icon Gloc-9 celebrates his 29th anniversary in the music industry with “Mga Ani ni Gloc-9,” his first-ever vinyl record featuring 11 of his greatest hits from different record labels throughout his illustrious career. Produced by Universal Records, this limited-edition collection marks a significant milestone in the career of one of the Philippines’ most celebrated rap artists. Known for his powerful storytelling, sharp lyricism, and ability to capture the realities of Filipino life through rap, Gloc-9 has built a lasting legacy that continues to resonate with generations of listeners.
